# telnyx_storage_migration (Data Source)

A migration that copies a bucket from a migration source into Telnyx Storage. The API cannot delete migrations; stop one with the telnyx_storage_migration_stop action.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the data migration.

### Read-Only

- `bytes_migrated` (Number) Total amount of data that has been succesfully migrated.
- `bytes_to_migrate` (Number) Total amount of data found in source bucket to migrate.
- `created_at` (String) Time when data migration was created
- `eta` (String) Estimated time the migration will complete.
- `last_copy` (String) Time when data migration was last copied from the source.
- `refresh` (Boolean) If true, will continue to poll the source bucket to ensure new data is continually migrated over.
- `source_id` (String) ID of the Migration Source from which to migrate data.
- `speed` (Number) Current speed of the migration.
- `status` (String) Status of the migration.
- `target_bucket_name` (String) Bucket name to migrate the data into. Will default to the same name as the `source_bucket_name`.
- `target_region` (String) Telnyx Cloud Storage region to migrate the data to.
